misc.ab.title: API monthly limit

misc.ab.body: The monthly limit (in dollars) set in the Anthropic console. Leave it empty to show spending only.
misc.ab.no_key: No admin key. Create one in the admin keys menu of the console settings and paste it.

misc.dsk.public_on: Opened for the public address too

misc.run.interrupted: It stopped before the last turn finished
misc.run.ask_missing: Couldn't find the question. Check it in Alerts
misc.intro.home_t: Home shows what to look at today
misc.intro.home_b: New mail, things waiting for your answer and running work gather as cards. Tap the bell at the top to see alerts on their own.
misc.intro.chat_b: Write the way you talk. A message sent while it's working cuts in right away. Anything that goes out, like mail, is always asked about before it's sent.
misc.intro.proj_t: Each project has its own conversations
misc.intro.proj_b: One folder is one project. Sessions and results stay with their project, so they don't mix.
misc.intro.mon_b: It watches mail, comments and site changes and tells you. Reply drafts are edited and sent here too.
misc.intro.set_t: Open apps and settings when you need them
misc.intro.set_b: Accounts, messengers and web access are changed in Settings. You can see this guide again in Settings.
misc.intro.set_b_apps: Apps you added open in the Apps tab. Accounts, messengers and web access are changed in Settings. You can see this guide again in Settings.
misc.pd.chat_only: Splitting works only in the Chat tab
misc.pd.full: Two panes at most, so this one is replaced
misc.pd.narrow: The window is narrow, so it opens here
misc.pk.max: You can open up to two panes
misc.pk.narrow: The window is too narrow to split
misc.pk.none: No other conversation to open side by side
misc.pl.name: Layout name
misc.pl.overwrite: A layout with the same name is overwritten.
misc.pane.tap_room: Tap this pane to open the chat room
misc.pane.bar_tip: Drag to resize, double-click for half and half
